name: tpt-validex
description: Validate millions of records per second. One schema, every language. Zero Apache-2.0-only dependencies.
author: TPT Solutions

scripts.build: cargo build -p tpt-valid-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --out-dir pkg --target web target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/tpt_valid_wasm.wasm
scripts.build:node: cargo build -p tpt-valid-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --out-dir pkg --target nodejs target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/tpt_valid_wasm.wasm
